quotes.text: Every sunrise is an invitation to begin again.
Open the window, breathe deeply, and let today be lighter than yesterday.
A calm morning sets the rhythm for a strong day.
Good morning! Small steps taken early travel the farthest.
The sun does not ask permission to shine; neither should you.
Start the day with gratitude and the rest will follow.
Fresh light, fresh mind, fresh chances — good morning.
Wake up with purpose and greet the day with a smile.
